headline: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting

meeting.body: Maui MPO Technical Advisory Committee Meeting
meeting.summary: The committee approved urban boundary and road classification updates and heard a proposal to extend the transportation plan update to March.
meeting.recap: A consultant said the plan will be finalized by the end of December.[[0:23:09]] The state is updating urban boundaries and road classifications for the first time since 2012.[[0:26:19]] One proposal upgrades Maui Lani Parkway because of growth in Central Maui.[[0:41:25]] A road's classification decides whether it can get federal highway money.[[0:45:19]] The committee voted to approve the urban boundary and road classification updates.[[0:58:07]] The executive director said the current long range transportation plan expires at the end of the year.[[0:59:50]] The director asked to give the consultants until the end of March, instead of February, to finish the plan update.[[1:04:36]] Until a new plan is adopted, the list of funded projects (the TIP) cannot be changed.[[1:14:37]] The next committee meeting is December 10, 2024 at 9:00 a.m.[[1:28:30]]
decided: The committee approved the urban boundary and road classification updates.
The rest of the executive director's report was deferred because of time.
meeting.next: The urban boundary update goes next to the policy board, then to the state for acceptance, then to federal highway officials. The director's proposed changes to the plan update go to the policy board this month.

moments.q: Consultant asks for approval of urban boundary and road classification reports
"it's kind of a catch 22" — member on FEMA and federal highway funds
State manager: March is okay "as long as it doesn't affect the spring revision schedule"
